usage: 牛腩湯 is a noun and refers to a specific type of soup made with beef brisket.
You can use 牛腩湯 as the subject or object in a sentence when talking about food.
When ordering food, you might say 我想食牛腩湯 to indicate you want beef brisket soup.
牛腩湯 often appears as a main dish on a restaurant menu.
It can be combined with other words to describe the dish more, like spicy 牛腩湯.
